entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Allow Analyzer ProjectReference Dependencies to Be Loaded Automatically (Parity with NuGet/VSIX) #79272
  • NavBar integration tests broken due to type change #79270
  • Unexpected behavior of property increment when receiver is a generic type parameter substituted with a reference type #79268
  • Sync namespaces doesn't work in .NET MAUI project #79263
  • Maui Project Automatic Namespace Adjustment Mangles Explcit References to Old Namespace with "Unmerged Changes" #79262

Closed

  • Miscellaneous files not shown as misc #78590
  • Follow up work items for extension operators #79136

PullRequests

Created

  • Make tests non-async #79278
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Update debugger contracts to 18.0.0-beta.25353.1 #79277
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add cookbook section for avoiding inheritance #79276
    Area-IDE
  • Completion for `#:project` paths #79275
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Initial support for adding obsolete attributes to primary constructors #79271
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode

Merged

  • Backport "Do not use a constructed method symbol in a BoundMethodDefIndex" to release/dev17.14 #79236
  • Inline strings in test code #79274
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Allow the Razor extension to report telemetry (and initialize) #79254
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Use same location for 'use implicit object' as we do for 'use collection expression'. #79265
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode, Next
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'main-vs-deps' #79273
    Next
  • Use the miscellaneous files project name for rich misc projects #79267
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • [release/dev17.14] Fix corruption of sliding text window when trying to peek backwards. #79266
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'main-vs-deps' #79261
    Next
  • Address follow-up comments for extension operators #79249
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Backport quick info crash when hovering over PP directives #79256
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Updated

  • Project options #79239
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Support using a simple overload resolution for finding Await helpers from the BCL #79135
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Move to .NET 10 P5 SDK and Arcade 10 SDK #78925
    VSCode
  • Extensions: extension grouping type names #79217
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Remove duplicate code for processing arrays vs strings #79233
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix ref safety of user-defined increment operators #79034
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Ref Fields
  • [release/dev17.12] Update dependencies to ensure coherency #78713
  • [release/dev17.13] Update dependencies to ensure coherency #78344
    Area-Infrastructure, untriaged
